text:
Lorenzo Ricci  
Email: l.ricci@healthinsightanalytics.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/lorenicci | GitHub: github.com/lorenicci | Location: Milan, Italy  

A data engineering professional with three years of experience in building scalable data infrastructure for healthtech enterprises. Specialized in designing cloud-native data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, and ensuring robust data governance. Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions that drive operational efficiency and support advanced analytics.  

At HealthInsight Analytics, I led the redesign of their data warehouse architecture, transitioning from a legacy system to a modern Snowflake-based solution. This involved creating a unified data model that integrated patient records, clinical data, and financial metrics, enabling real-time analytics for 12+ internal teams. I also spearheaded the implementation of a cloud cost optimization strategy, reducing infrastructure expenses by 18% through resource tagging and automated scaling policies. My work directly supported the development of predictive analytics models used in chronic disease management, which improved diagnostic accuracy by 12% in pilot programs.  

In my previous role at VitalCare Technologies, I focused on building and maintaining ETL pipelines that processed over 500 million records monthly. These pipelines, built with Apache Spark and Airflow, ensured timely data ingestion for reporting and machine learning workflows. I also managed the company’s AWS infrastructure, deploying Terraform to automate environment provisioning and implementing Kubernetes for container orchestration. A key project involved integrating Apache Kafka to handle real-time patient monitoring data, which reduced latency in alert systems by 25%.  

During my internship at HealthTrack Innovations, I contributed to the development of a data visualization tool using Python and Tableau, which simplified reporting for non-technical stakeholders. This experience laid the foundation for my focus on data accessibility and automation in subsequent roles.  

**Projects**  
1. **HealthInsight Data Warehouse Overhaul**  
   - Redesigned a star-schema data model in Snowflake to support cross-functional analytics, reducing query latency by 30%  
   - Implemented dbt for data transformation, improving pipeline reliability and version control  
   - Collaborated with data scientists to ensure schema alignment with machine learning workloads  

2. **Real-Time Patient Monitoring System**  
   - Built a Kafka-powered pipeline to ingest and process telemetry data from 50+ medical devices  
   - Integrated Spark Streaming for anomaly detection, enabling sub-second alert generation  
   - Deployed Docker containers on Kubernetes to ensure high availability during peak usage  

3. **Cloud Cost Optimization Initiative**  
   - Analyzed AWS spending patterns and identified 20+ cost-saving opportunities  
   - Automated resource tagging and implemented Spot Instance strategies for batch jobs  
   - Reduced monthly cloud expenses by 18% while maintaining 99.9% SLA

Master’s in Data Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (2021)
